title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Agent 365 agents as connected agents in declarative agents
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout dates, administrator-installed default and documented control paths and API calls are supported. Minor corrections should report conflicting Microsoft guidance on authentication, connection limits and billing, and replace the older plan-specific governance wording with the service description's current wording.

claims.claim: Microsoft is adding Agent2Agent-enabled Agent 365 agents as connected agents in declarative agents.
claims.quote: Microsoft is introducing support for Microsoft Agent 365 agents that implement the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, allowing them to be used as connected agents in declarative agents built with Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit.

claims.claim: The roadmap title describes using Agent 365 agents within Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and declarative agents.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Agent 365 agents within Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Declarative Agents

claims.claim: The roadmap description names connected agents for agents built in Agent Builder or Copilot Studio.
claims.quote: If the agent implements the Agent2Agent protocol, it can be used as a connected agent for the agents that users build in Agent Builder or Copilot Studio.
